title: O COME
LET US SING
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: sunlit forest glades peaceful morning light
misty countryside in soft golden light
golden light over calm quiet landscape
peaceful river winding through green trees
sunbeams breaking through ancient quiet trees
morning dew glistening on quiet meadow grass

scenes.a: That unshakeable heaviness in your chest right now is asking for a different anchor today.
Father, we quiet our wandering minds before Your throne and remember Your steadfast faithfulness.
O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
Lord, You have been our dwelling place in all generations, holding us when the road grew steep.
Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
Accept our humble praise this day, and let our gratitude be a sweet offering unto Your holy name.
